draft_en.subject: One question, Saeed
draft_en.body:
Hi Saeed,

One question only, since your team has had our catalogue and the mails since were general ones: which line fits your current projects - managed 8/24-port PoE switches for CCTV, or DIN-rail industrial units - so I send the price list for that family and nothing else?

The Tofino-type industrial router you asked about in 2024 we still do not make - said again so you do not wait on it.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
